name: Sianna
description: A Farrelite champion who wore a powerful cloak.

description_citations.text: "Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oliver Farrel whips Montford into a frenzy against the Ebon Hand and appoints Sianna as his champion to slay Tymolin.
timeline.quote: Farrel then appoints Sianna to be his champion bestowing his mantle upon her.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 1: Rumors of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Farrelites ambush Tev and Tymolin; Tev summons a Wall of Bone, disenchants Farrel's mantle and escapes with a Darkness spell, but the siblings are separated.
timeline.quote: Not recognizing Tev to be a powerful planeswalker the blood cult attacks the pair ignoring him.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 1: Rumors of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sensing her death, Tev transforms into a dragon-like Tevesh Szat and incinerates Vaylesh, Oliver and Sianna and their forces.
timeline.quote: Tev now Tevesh Szat soared in incinerating the thrull and all present including Vaylesh, Oliver, and Sianna.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 2: Nations Asunder". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oliver Farrel and the Farrelites attack Tev and Tymolin; Tev disenchants Sianna's cloak and Tymolin is separated from him.
timeline.quote: Oliver Farrel and his Farrelites attacked Tev and Tymolin.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sensing his sister's death, Tev fully transforms into a serpentine dragon form and incinerates the Ebon Hand encampment, killing Sianna, Farrel and Vaylesh.
timeline.quote: Tev incinerated everyone present, including Sianna, Oliver Farrel, and Vaylesh.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Farrel ambushes Tymolin and Tev; Tev dispels the mantle from Sianna and is then lost in Havenwood, letting Tymolin be captured.
timeline.quote: Tev dispelled the mantle from Sianna, defeating and angering Farrel

citation.text: "Farrelites", section "Death of Farrel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tev arrives as Tevesh Szat and incinerates the Farrelites and Ebon Hand, killing Farrel and Sianna.
timeline.quote: incinerating all present, including Farrel and Sianna

citation.text: "Farrelites", section "Death of Farrel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oliver gives Sianna his mantle as champion and tries to kill Tymolin with his Aeolipile; Tev kills several members and disenchants the mantle.
timeline.quote: Tev responded with fury killing several members and disenchanting the mantle off of Sianna.

citation.text: "Oliver Farrel", section "Loss of the Mantle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tev, newly transformed as Tevesh Szat, incinerates everyone present including Oliver and Sianna; the Farrelites consider them martyrs.
timeline.quote: Enraged at his sister's death, Tev appeared as the newly transformed Tevesh Szat

citation.text: "Oliver Farrel", section "Martyrdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
